title: ErrorEnvelope
description: Body of every non-2xx HTTP response on the platform's public APIs, and of SSE 'error' events. user_message is safe to show or speak; diagnostics belong in logs keyed by correlation_id, never in this object. Small in-body errors inside ToolResult and DomainResponse keep using common ErrorInfo. See DEC-008.

code.description: UPPER_SNAKE code. Open set: clients must treat unknown codes by their retryable and effect_state flags. Registry: docs/contracts/README.md#error-codes.

retryable.description: true = the same request may be sent again automatically (honour retry_after_ms).

effect_state.description: Whether the request had a persistent effect. unknown = it may have been applied (e.g. a timeout while applying a confirmed proposal); clients must not replay it and must re-read state first.

user_message.description: Short, non-technical, safe to speak aloud: no amounts, no account data, no stack traces.

degraded_to.description: Fallback the platform has already switched to, if any.

allOf.$comment: An action that may already have happened must never be retried automatically.
A retry hint only makes sense on a retryable error.
